title: 6f Gene peak counts
source: Source: Original nonVZ DE CSV, ME3 FTneg DiffBind CSV and mouse gene-body annotation.
method: Method: Original gene-centric script: RNA nominal P<0.05; ME3 peak FDR<0.1; classify Fold>0.5 versus Fold<=0.5. Unit is gene-peak overlap; a peak linked to multiple genes contributes once per gene. The low-fold category has already passed FDR<0.1.

method: Method: Recorded balanced-downsampling analysis settings. This empirical sign-tail fraction is distinct from a Gaussian pnorm test or shuffled-label permutation test.
